title: Fizz Nic Shot 10ml - 18mg
description: Enhance your e-liquid with a fizzy twist using the Fizzy Nic Shot from Mixto. This 10ml bottle contains 18mg of nicotine, offering a satisfying nicotine hit while adding a unique effervescent sensation to your favourite e-liquids. Perfect for vapers who enjoy a sparkling The Fizzy Nic Shot is designed to be mixed with shortfills, allowing you to customise your 0mg high-VG e-liquids with nicotine while adding a delightfully tangy fizz. Simply add the nic shot to your chosen shortfill bottle, shake well, and enjoy a sparkling effect that works particularly well with fruity and confectionary flavours. How to use the Fizzy Nic Shot: 1 . Open your shortfill e-liquid bottle and remove the nib. 2 . Pour the entire Fizzy Nic Shot into the shortfill bottle. 3 . Reattach the nib and secure the lid. 4 . Shake the bottle vigorously for a minute to ensure the nicotine and fizz are evenly distributed. 5 . Your e-liquid is now ready to vape. The Fizzy Nic Shot is made with high-quality ingredients to ensure a premium vaping experience. It is best used with high VG shortfill e-liquids for sub-ohm vaping, but can also be used with 50/50 blends for some MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices like pod kits.
